Subject: Re: [opensuse] Nvidia GPU and Xen

On Sat, 23 Feb 2008 22:14:03 -0300, Ciro Iriarte wrote:

>Not really, according to Nvidia, the kmp packages "are entirely built,
>maintained and supported by Novell/SUSE".

Built yes, supported and maintained not! Yes, we build the kmp, but
that's based on the driver package Nvidia provides and this contains a
binary only object which SuSE/Novell can't modify! Try building the
driver yourself based on the driver package you can download from Nvidia
and you'll see what I mean.

Because of the closed source nature of the Nvidia driver and as we have
no access to the sources we simply can't offer maintenance or support
for the package. 

Philipp
